texts.orig: Recommendations contained in the Multi-Year Plan include:
texts.text: Recommendations contained in the Multi-Year Plan include:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. Restructuring the administration of the program to assure quality, efficiency, and positive individual/family outcomes and satisfaction.
texts.text: Restructuring the administration of the program to assure quality, efficiency, and positive individual/family outcomes and satisfaction.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. Shifting priorities for resource allocation from facility-based programs to services that build on natural supports.
texts.text: Shifting priorities for resource allocation from facility-based programs to services that build on natural supports.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. Creating mechanisms for individuals and families to control resources allocated to meet their need.
texts.text: Creating mechanisms for individuals and families to control resources allocated to meet their need.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4. Pursuing regulatory reform.
texts.text: Pursuing regulatory reform.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5. Unifying funding and eliminating categoricals within the mental retardation system.
texts.text: Unifying funding and eliminating categoricals within the mental retardation system.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6. Reinvesting savings from system reorganization into community services.
texts.text: Reinvesting savings from system reorganization into community services.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7. Provide services and supports in the community for 1,500 people who are currently living in State ICFs/MR over 5 years.
texts.text: Provide services and supports in the community for 1,500 people who are currently living in State ICFs/MR over 5 years.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8. Transfer state and federal funding for 2,100 persons who live in non-state ICFs/MR into the community funding system by conversion to the Medicaid Waiver.
texts.text: Transfer state and federal funding for 2,100 persons who live in non-state ICFs/MR into the community funding system by conversion to the Medicaid Waiver.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Self Determination
texts.text: Self Determination

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The principles of self determination hold that all individuals have the right to determine the course of their own lives.  All individuals need to be free to exercise this right and to accept responsibility for their decisions.  It is recognized, however, that some individuals require a greater degree of support in doing this than others.  Family members and friends provide support and have a role in helping individuals determine and achieve their life goals.  In this process, government plays a supportive role as necessary.
